summary: Sarah's worst week since onboarding. Vivek recovered jxstin.media on Aug 8, but the next morning her MAIN Instagram (@sarah.h44, 530k) went down — the third time her main account has been lost since Nov 2025, and eight days after Derrek's Aug 1 letter promising a $40k Phone Farm would end exactly this. Separately she raised her first-ever earnings complaint on Aug 8 ('why have I gone down to 3k') and waited ~45 hours for a reply, which came from Ronnie Chat as a question back ('How are socials going for you ?? Any issues there ?') two days after her main IG had been suspended. The two IG accounts she has been chasing since Aug 6 were never touched. She then went silent from Aug 11 through week end — highly unusual for a client who normally sends 20+ messages a week. Bright spots: the leak-removal breakdown and reel inspo both landed on cadence, and there was zero payment friction.
